tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dha ཾ / stan bde ba la sky-il mo krung gis bsdad la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ sdug bsngal med cing bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*| sdug bsngal gyi rgyu chags sdang dang bral te chos brgyad mgo snyoms par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i don du ting nge 'dzin sgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 ham̐/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ de nas skad cig gis rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems hriḥs mtshan par bsam| de las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las/ thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas thams cad la sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul ba/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na phreng ba dkar po 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og mas rin po che dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*| mgul rgyan dang*/ ska rags la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' mnabs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa/ spyi bo na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam pas dbu brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsams la/ yid cung zad bzung*/ de nas spyi bo na bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la dmigs nas/

bla ma bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes zhe thag pa nas gsol ba lan gsum gdab| de nas bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang*/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtsa ba thams cad sems yin la/ sems de brtags na kha dog dang dbyibs su grub pa med cing*/ gcig dang du ma ma yin pas na rang gi sems ngo bos stong ngo bo med pa'i dbang gis gdod nas skye ba med pas dang po skye ba'i rgyus stong*/ skye ba med pa'i phyir sdod sa med pas bar du gnas pas stong*/ gnas med pa'i phyir 'jig rgyu med pas mthar 'gag pas stong bas gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing*/ spros pa thams cad dang bral bas nam mkha' lta bu zhes spros pa bcad la mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgoms zhing*/ yid la mi byed pas spros bral gyi ngang la yid glod de mnyam par gzhag go /goms pa dang sems mi g.yo zhing*| gnas pa yun ring zhing mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rang gi snying khar hriḥbasgoms pa la sngags kyi phreng ba 'od kyi tshul du 'phros pas| sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul bdag la byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ sems can rnams la phog pas sgrib pa thams cad dag nas/ tshogs gnyis bsags par bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes ci nus bzla'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ spyod lam sna tshogs kyi tshe/ rang 'dug pa'i gnas bde ba can yin la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhabs drung na/ jo bo thugs rje chen por gnas pa yin snyam pa'i bsam pas spyad par bya'o/

/de ltar rtag tu byas na tshe 'dir tshe ring zhing*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba/ skye ba phyi mar bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas| myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul/ chos rje sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di/ rang gi slob ma mo ston byu 'phur zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ me mo bya'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la/ skyer kha mdor 'phags pas yi ger bkod pa'o/ /chos tshul 'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ phyag na pad+mo dgra las rnam rgyal dang*/ /rdo rje gdan pa yab sras ba ri dang*/ /kun dga' snying po bsod nams rtse mo dang*/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// 'gro mgon chos rgyal dga' ldan bkra shis dpal/ /bla ma kun bsod dpal ldan seng ge dang*/ /chos rje bsod nams zhabs dang kun dga'i mtshan/ / legs par brgyud dai bdag la gnang ba'o// // ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ )( tsun dha'i sgrub pa'i thabs rgyud las 'byung ba'i rim pa bzhugs so/ / ) ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ tan+t+ra ud bha ba kra ma tsun dha sā dha nāṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ tsun dha'i sgrub pa'i thabs rgyud las 'byung ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ skul byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gnyis med las/ /byung pa'i rnam 'phrul sgyu ma'i sku/ /tsun dha de la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi bsgrub pa'i rim pa bshad| |dang por re zhig sngags pa yis/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi/ khrus kyis lus sogs dag byas nas/ /ji skad bshad pa'i cho ga yis/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs bdag nyid/ /bsags te stong nyid byang chub las/ /tsum gyi ye shes las sgrubs pa/ /skul byed ces bya'i gzungs lha mo/ /rgyal ba sku gsung bdag nyid can/ /bye ba phrag bdun gyis ston pa/ /yi ge dgu yi bdag nyid can||lha dgu rnams kyi gnas kyang yin/

/zhal gsum ston ka'i 'dam bu'i mdog |na chung skal ldan dar la bab/ /rig sngags thams cad sgrol mdzad ma// rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /rtsa zhal bzhad cing spyan gsum ldan// g.yas kyi zhal ni rnam gdangs pa/ /ud pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra'i mdog/ mche ba zla tshes shar ba bzhin/ /lce ni glog bzhin rnam par 'gyu/ /g.yon pa btso ma'i gser mdog can/ /tshems kyis sgros ni rnam par mnan/ /rol pa'i stabs su legs par gnas/ /sna tshogs gdub bus brgyan pa yi/ /phyag ni nyi shu rtsa drug gi /dang po gnyis kyi rtsa ba yi/ /phyag rgyas snying kha'i gnas su brgyan// g.yas kyi gnyis pa mi 'jigs sbyin/ /gsum pas ral gri 'bar ba ste/ /bzhi pas yid bzhin nor bu'o/ /lnga pas sa bon gang ba 'dzin/ /drug pas mda' ni gsor byed cing*/ /bdun pa na ni dgra sta 'dzin/ /brgyad pa'i phyag na dbyug tho'o| |dgu pa na ni tho ba ste/ /bcu pa'i phyag na lcags kyu'o/ /bcu gcig pa na rdo rje 'dzin/ /bcu gnyis phyag gi se gol sgras/ /bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bskrod par byed/ /bcu gsum pa na bgrang phreng ngo*/ /de bzhin g.yon pa'i gnyis pa na/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni pad+ma'o// bzhi pas ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /lnga pa na ni zhags pa ste/ /drug pa na ni gzhu nyid do/ /bdun pa mdung thung gsor byed cing*/ /brgyad pa'i phyag na 'khor lo'o||dgu pa na ni dung 'dzin cing*/ /bcu pas bgegs la bsdigs mdzub mdzad| |bcu gcig pa na bum pa bzang*/ /bcu gnyis pa na thag mdung ngo*// bcu gsum pa yi phyag gis ni/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa 'dzin/ /'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ /pad+ma la bzhugs bsgom par bya/ /lwa ba'i na bza'i stod g.yogs dang*/ /sna tshogs tshi gur bcas pa yi/ /shing lo gsar pa'i smad g.yogs can/ /me tog 'bras bus rnam spud pa'i/ /sna tshogs shing lo bla brer bris/

/cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gzugs 'phro| |byin brlabs ye shes sbyor ldan pas/ /dbang bskur spyi bor phan pas brgyan| |sum cu'i lha rnams ltung ba dang*/ /bgegs rnams shin tu 'jigs skrag nas/ /thal mo sbyor bar byed pa'o/ /'di 'dra gang zhig rtag bsgom zhing*// bsgrims nas gsang sngags brjod pa des/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob 'gyur na// dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /ting 'dzin ngo mtshar thob 'gyur zhing*// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /mdzub gnyis gung mo'i tshigs dbus mar/ /gdu bu'i tshul du byas nas ni/ /mtheb gnyis brkyang nas rab sbyar ba/ /'di yi phyag rgya chen po'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nam̐| samyak+sam̐bud+dha ko ṭi nan/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun dhe swāhā/ rig sngags 'di ni bzlas pa dang*/ /bsgoms pa yi ni sbyor ba yis/ /'dod don grub cing lha mo sogs| |kun nas nye bar longs spyod byed/ /skul byed ma yi gnyis med thugs||bskul nas dngos grub bsgrub byed pa/ /sgrub pa'i thabs 'di byas pa yi| |de yi go 'phang thob par shog /skul byed ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs rgyud las 'byung ba'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 'phags pas sa pho rta'i lo dbyu gu'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// // ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /bsrung ba lnga yi cho ga bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo||bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ rim pa 'di ltar bya ste/ sa chog dgos pa'i phyogs su/ cho ga gzhan ltar byas la 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i maṇ+ḍal dris byugs pa'i steng du thig btab la/ de'i nyin mo bri ba ma grub na/ me tog gi tshom bu la brten te cho ga rgyas bsdus ci grub bya/ nangs par dkyil 'khor bri bar bya ste/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad/

phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog la lha mo lnga'i phyag mtshan nam/ sa bon nam gdan dgod/ mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon la bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dgod/ de'i phyi rol pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ phyogs skyong bcu/ mdun rgyab kyi 'dab ma la gnyis gnyis/ de'i phyir rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la gza' dgu/ mdun gyi rtsibs la nyi ma dang gnyis dgod| de'i phyi rol du mu khyud la rgyu skar nyer brgyad dgod/ sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi'i ming ngam/ brda'am/ thig le bri/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor mdzes shing rdzogs par bri/ bum pa lnga'am/ gcig kha rgyan dang bcas pa bshams/ gzhan yang phur pa bzhi/ mda' dgu la sogs pa la tshon skud kyi dra ba bya/ shar du gzungs grwa lnga khri'i steng du bzhugs/ g.yon nas brtsams la mchod pa lnga la sogs pa 'byor pa la tshad med pa bsham/ gzhan yang gtor ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la| sngon 'gro dang bgegs gtor dang*/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi phyi ma lnga dmar gtor bya/ gzhan bcu bzhi dkar gtor bya'o/ /gzhan yang byur bsal ba dang*/ byab bsrung dang*/ bkra shis kyi rdzas dang*/ rol mo la sogs dgos pa rnams 'tshog chas bya/ de nas dus bzang po la khrus byas la phyag 'tshal/ gso sbyong blangs nas/ sangs rgyas spyod yul mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bden pa rab ston thub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bden pa'i stobs kyis 'gro ba ma lus sgrol mdzad pas/ /bdag gi bya ba thams cad 'bras bu mchis par mdzod| |ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis/ sngon 'gro yak+ṣa dang*/ rdo rje mes sbyang*/ a kā ros bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ de rnams gtor ma gzhan la 'dre/ de nas sarba big+nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo la sogs pas/ gtor ma bsngos la mtshams bcad do/ /gzhan dkyus dang tho yig gnyis na gsal lo// // ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /'phags pa rin po che'i dga' ba'i gtam sogs bzhugs so/

/ ༄༅༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ gang gis spyan ras kyis gzigs pas/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rab bsal nas/ /bde chen gnas la 'god mdzad pa/ /bla ma mchog la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag ni sngon tshe tshogs bsags pas/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi lus thob/ /thub pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa rin chen mchog la zhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo'i sku/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed dang*| |smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur te/ /sdom pa gsum dang ldan par byas||bslab par bya ba'i phyogs 'ga' 'ang*/ /ci rigs par ni bdag gis bslabs||bden pa rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung bcu gnyis dang*| |bsod nams dang ni ye shes tshogs/ /pha rol phyin pa drug dang ni||rim gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /de nyid ji bzhin bdag gis rtogs||de ltar lam gyi mthar thug pa/ /'bras bu rnam smin sku dang ni/ /de bzhin rnam par grol ba'i sku/ /chos kyi sku dang sprul pa'i sku/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang ni/ /de bzhin longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /shin tu rnam dag ngo bo'i sku/ /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don grub pa/ /so so'i 'bras bu bdag gis shes/ /de lta'i theg pa rnam gsum yang*/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten la dgongs nas/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /lam ni rnam pa gsum du bstan| |skal ba bzang po'i rnal 'byor bdag /theg pa gsum la rab zhugs kyang*| |rdo rje theg pa mchog gi lam// byang chub sems kyis rab brgyan pa// gtso bor bdag gis nyams su blangs// blangs pa'i 'bras bu sku lnga dang*/ /ye shes lnga ni bdag gis 'thob/ /de tshe bdag gis sems can kun/ /bde ba mchog la 'god par bya/ /de lta'i sems dpa' mchog ldan pa/ /gang yin de ni blo gros mchog /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa po/ /chos kyi dpal 'byor gyis mdzes pa/

/skal ba bzang po'i rnal 'byor bdag /shin tu bde ba'i gnas pas gnas/ /e ma'o e ma'o ngo mtshar che'o/ /bdag gis sems can khyed cag la| |lam mchog 'di la gnas par ni//thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ khyed cag nyid la smin pa mchi// dga' bas tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ /dge ba'i don du bdag gis sbyar/ /dge ba de yis sems can kun/ /dga' ba'i go 'phang la gnas shog /dga' ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dga' ba'i gtam zhes bya ba/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/ /maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu| shu bhaṃ// // ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ )( bcom ldan ral gri la spring ba/ ) ༄༅/ /gdong bzhi'i thor tshugs zhi ba'i zla tshes dang*/ /dbang po'i cod pan nye bar 'bar ba yis/ /gang zhig zhabs pad dri med la btud pa/ /de'i gsung rab phyogs bcur rgyal gyur cig /blo gros dkyil 'khor smra ba'i 'od 'byin pa/ /'phags pa'i ming du grags pa gang yin pas/ /rigs dang rigs min lta ba'i mig gsal ba/ /rigs smra rigs pa'i dbang phyug de la spring*/ khyod kyis bkod pa'i legs bshad phreng*/ /phal cher 'thad pa gsum gyis grub// tshig sbyor dri med mdangs bkra ba/ /mthong bas dga' ba yar zla bzhin/ khyod la le los rnam kun tu/ kha na ma thor mi 'gyur mod/ /yul rkyen dman dang ma tshang dang*/ /'gal ba sgrub pa sna tshogs kyis/ /skyo dang zhum pa'i yid sol la// yid 'phrog pa dang don gsal dang*/ /don la nges par bya ba'i phyir/ /gcig tu brtson par gyis shig dang*/ /zhing la sprin bzhin bdag 'gyur grang*/ khyod blo dge ba las byung gzhan/ /dus la bab tshe lta bar spro/ /gang gis lhag bsam dge ba las/ /byung ba'i spring yig dam pa 'di/ /kun da'i tshal du zla zer can// kun nas 'jug par 'gyur zhig grang*/ /shes rab me tog brtson 'grus chab kyis bskrun/ /ting 'dzin snying po tshul khrims ze'u 'brus spud/ /bzod pa'i mdangs gsal sbyin pa'i sbrang rtsi'i ros/

/gdul bya'i bung ba tshims mdzad rnam par rgyal/ /ma rungs gang dag rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud/ /me yi shing ltar kun nas sreg byed pa/ /mu mtha' med par srid lam rgyu ba la/ /mi mchog rnams kyi'ang mdzad pa'i yul min na/ /'khu 'khrig can gyi chos don ma 'tshal zhing*/ khe dang bkur sti 'du 'dzis rnam g.yeng pa/ kho bo lta bus smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal| |dge slong 'phags pas/ bcom ldan ral gri la spring ba'i yi ge'o//

( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ )( kun dga' smon lam la spring ba/ ) ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ skye rgu'i sgron ma 'bar zhing rab gsal ba/ /mun pa'i tshogs bcom lhang nge gnas pa ltar/ /che ba'i yon tan du mas rab gsal ba| |bde gshegs snang byed de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos smra ba'i btsun pa 'phags pas/ bla ma'i gsung rab bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /blo gros rin chen bum pa yongs bltams nas/ /chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed par rab brtson pa// kun dga' smon lam khyod la don 'di spring*/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i rgya mtsho las byung ba/ /rigs pa'i seng ge skal ldan shing rta'i rgyun/ /'dzam gling gdul bya'i don kun nyer bsgrubs nas/ /zag med rgya mtshor zhi bar gshegs so zhes// ngag dang 'phrin gyi yi ge las rtogs pas/ /rang yid gdung bar gyur mod de lta na'ang*| |sems can kun gyi gnas lugs 'di yin zhing*/ /rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi rnam thar bas/ /ji ltar bya ba'i thabs tshul ma shes so/ /de nyid phyir na mkhas rnams kyis/ /mya ngan gdung ba rab bsal nas/ /bla ma'i phrin las rdzogs phyir dang*/ /bde gshegs bstan pa gnas phyir dang*/ /re ba'i skye bo tshims bya'i phyir/ /brtson pa'i go cha cher gyon te/ /dam pa rnams kyi rnam thar la||rab tu 'bad par bya ba'i rigs/ /dge bshes rgyal mtshan dpal yang nga'i drung du sleb/ khyed kyi yi ge yig rten dang bcas pa lag tu phyin/ don rnams kyang go nged kyi sems pa la slob dpon pa mi bzhugs kyang khyed sku mched gcig dang*| slob dpon pa'i slob ma yon tan dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig 'ong snyam du bsams pa la re ba stobs ldan nyon mongs te/ re ba med pa bde ba'i mchog/ ces gsungs don dang mtshungs par ni/ /re bas re ba bcom par gyur/ /'on kyang bsam pa dag pas kun bslangs nas/ /'byor pa shin tu dman gyur kyang*// dka' bar ring nas 'ongs gyur pa/ /'di dag bdag gis bskyang bar bya/

/slad ma skabs don la/ bla ma chos rje'i bka' drin dran par gyis la de'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dam tshig la dgongs la/ dpal sa skya nyid du bzhugs nas bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas slob ma'i tshogs bskyang ba dang*/ chos rje rin po che'i grub mtha' dri ma med pa 'di rgyas par mdzad do/ /log par sgrub pa rnams rang la rang gis gnod pa yin/ gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa ma lags| log pa'i rkyen gyis mi 'phrog par mdzod/ phye ma leb dang 'dab chags dang*/ /rgya mtsho dag gis ri rab ltar/ khyed ni grogs ngan sdug bsngal dang*| |mi snyan brjod pas ma g.yo shig khyed rang gi bka' 'khor du gtogs pa rnams la zhal lta gyis la/ lus ngag zhi zhing dul ba dang*/ chags sdang gi spyod pa las bzlog par mdzod/ /dpag tshad bzhi khri'i steng nas rgyu ba'i nyi ma yis// me tog pad ma'i tshal rab rgyas par byed/ /de bzhin kho bo rgyang ring gnas na gnas gyur kyang*/ /thabs tshul du mas khyed la kun ( tu ) phan par bgyi/ /gdung khebs kyi mtshan pa la ja rtse mo sig bzang ba gcig mchis/ bsam pa drang po dang ldan zhing*/ /mi mthun phyogs kyis mi bskyod par/ /gzhan la phan pa lhur len pa/ /'di 'dra srid pa gsum na dkon/ /bdag gi sems 'di khyed cag la||zla zer bzhin du rab 'jug kyang*/ khyed kyis blo gros gzhal med khang*// byang gi phyogs su mngon par phyogs/ /bsam pa dag pa las byung pa'i/ /gtam du bya ba 'di springs so/ /nyes pa snang gang bzod par mdzod/ /dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ /stag gi lo sgrog khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la bris pa'o|| || ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ / ༄༅/ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma ni/ dang po mdun du gtor ma bshams la/ lag pa thal mo kha phub pa bstan la/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsams/

g.yas pa bstan pas a zhes brjod pa/ thod pa dkar po dpral ba rang la bstan par bsam| gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la ho zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dkar mer gy-is song bar bsam ste/ gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /de nas lag pa gnyis dpral ba'i thad kar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas la bskor zhing gyen du lta ba la sogs pas/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra a ra li ho/ badz+ra ḍa ki ni sa ma ya staṃ tri sha ho/ zhes brjod pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ nyan thos la sogs pa dpag tu med pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs te/ de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas mgron de rnams la phog pas| de rnams yi dam gyi lha he ru ka'i rang bzhin du bsams/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa| sarba bhu dha/ pre ta pi sha tsa/ ud ma ta/ a pa sma ra/ ḍa ki ni dh+ya/ i maṃ bha liṃ gh+ri nan tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣa tu ma ma/ sarba sid dhiṃ me pra yad tsan+tu ya te baṃ/ ya te ta| bhu dza thā/ dzi ga thā/ pi pa ta/ ma ti pra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra/ tha pa su kha hi bhi shud dha ya swāhā yi ga bha wan tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod pas/ mgron de rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus sib sib gsol bas/ mnyes par bsam mo||de nas ngag tu 'di skad ces brjod do/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang*/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang*/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba dang*/ tshan rdo dang nye ba'i tshan rdo dang*/ thung gcod dang nye ba'i thung gcod dang*/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ yul sum bcu so gnyis la sogs pa na gnas pa/ sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje 'kha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/

pad ma'i mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ de rnams kyi bka' dang 'khor na gnas pa'i/ las las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro/ ma mo mkha' 'gro/ sha za mkha' 'gro/ dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams mchod pa dam par bzhes/ gzhan yang 'jigs byed chen po dgu| rgyal po chen po bzhi dang*/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ lha chen po brgyad dang*| klu chen po brgyad dang*/ gza' chen po brgyad dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs te/ gtsang rigs kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*| mdor na rig pa'i rgyal po'i tshogs dang*/ tshogs bdag gi tshogs dang*/ khro bo'i tshogs dang*/ pho nya'i tshogs dang*/ bran gyi tshogs su gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten pa nyi shu rtsa gcig 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gong ma rnams kyis bsgrub pa'i chos skyong dam tshig can rnams dang*/ dpal gyi ri dang*/ gu rad la sogs pa/ rgya gar yul na bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ pha na phiṃ gu la sogs pa bal yul na bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ dpal sa skya dang*/ gnas po che lha rtse dang*/ yo se mo dang*/ mkhar chung dgon pa dang*| rked lhas la sogs pa dang*/ bod yul na bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ dpal rdo rje gdan dang*/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la sogs pa gnas chen po brgyad dang*| gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnams dang*/ bod khams su rten gtsugs pa'i gtsug lag khang*/ ra sa 'phrul snang dang*/ ka tshal dang*/ g.yu ri khra 'brug dang*/ rtsangs bram dang*/ grom pa rgyang la sogs pa ru bzhi'i gtsug lag khang dang*/ mtha' 'dul yang 'dul la sogs te/ gtsug lag khang gi bdag po dang*/ nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ rgyal po rnam thos sras/ las kyi gshin rje/ khyab 'jug ra hu la/ dge bsnyen chen po zur phud lnga pa yab sras 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa bod khams skyong ba'i srung ma dam tshig can rnams dang*/

gzhan yang yul bdag gzhi bdag rnams dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug skye ba rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ lan chags kyi mgron tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i bgegs dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i bgegs dang*/ 'jig rten la phan gnod byed pa'i lha 'dre rnams mchod pa dam par bzhes la/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang 'chad pa dang*/ sgrub pa/ bsam pa mthar ma phyin gyi bar du phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dngos grub thabs cad ma lus par bstsal du gsol/ ces brjod pas phrin las bcol la gtor ma gtang ngo*/ /mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma/ bla ma'i phyag len bzhin las dang po 'gas bskul nas don du 'phags pas sbyar ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ bha wan tu// ( lu phu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /thab 'bri tshul/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ thab la bri dang rtsig pa gnyis/ /dang po thig dang tshon gyis bri/ /gru bzhi la sogs tshad la ni/ /ba yi rnam lnga dri yis byug /cha chen brgyad du gdab pa la/ /dang po khung bur bskos ba la/ /sna tshog pad ma 'dab brgyad bri/ /lte ba rdo rje zangs gri dang*/ /phyogs 'dab 'khor lo rin chen dang*// pad ma ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ ka /mtshams su bum pa bzhi po dgod/ /gnyis pa gsum du bgos pa yis/ /dang por pad ma bri bar bya/ /bar pa stong pa gsum pa la// zangs gri'am gri gug bri bar bya/ /yang na dang po gri gug dang*/ /gsum pa rdo rje 'khor lo sogs/ /gsum pa gsum du bskor ba la/ /rdo rje pad ma 'khor lo yi||g.yon du gri gug bri bar bya'o/ /sgo bzhir lcags kyu la sogs sam/ /yang na sgo mtshams gri gug brgyad/ /bzhi pa gnyis su bgos pa la/ /lnga drug sgo yi thig btab la/ /sgo dang rtsigs pa 'dod yon dang*/ /pha gu dra phyed mda' yab bri||de yi phyi rol rta babs so/ /dur khrod phyi nas bskor ba la/ /mtshan ma nyi shu bri bar bya'o/

/yang na thig gi re khabacad/ /me tog tshom bu dgod par bya// zhes pa bri thab ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// // ( lu phu'i dpe las byung*/ )( bde mchog gi sgrub thabs ) bsgrub thabs 'di la gnyis te/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa dang*/ lha bsgom pa'o/ /de la gnyis/ stong pa nyid du bsgom pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de la gnyis/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ( gsum )/ sgrub pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa| gdan bsgom pa'o/ /lha bskyed pa la gsum/ sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gsum/ lhag par mos pa pha mes kyi ting nge 'dzin/ rnal 'byor rnam bzhi bu tsha'i ting nge 'dzin/ rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /bar pa la bzhi/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes su rnal 'byor dang*/ shin tu rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ lha'i rgyu mthun bsgom pa'o/ /rjes su rnal 'byor ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa nyid do// shin tu rnal 'byor la gnyis/ rdo rje mgon por bsgyur ba dang*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po la gnyis/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sems dpa' sum brtseg bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa rjes su chags pa sngon 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la lnga/ rig ma 'du bya ba dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ pad ma byin gyis brlab pa/ las la gnas pa/ mchod pa bya ba/ bha gar lha bskyed pa'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni/ lha re re zhing*/ dbyung ba/ spro ba/ bsdu ba ste bzhi bzhi'o/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la bdun| phra mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang*/ ngag gi bzlas pa dang*| don dam par 'jug pa dang*/ lha mo'i glus blang ba dang*/ bstod cing mchod pa dang*/ nye bar bsdu ba'o//

//shu bhaṃ// ( lu phu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /ma hā ma ya'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ /sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du ma hā ma ya bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sgrib pa dag ste/ ma hā ma yar gyur pa ni/ pad ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba/ g.yas ser ba/ rgyab dmar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs khar bsnams shing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyi mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan zhing*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ yid kyis mnyam par bzhag go /de nas rang gi snying kha'i nang du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar/ sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis rang gi sdig pa dag cing bsod nams 'phel bar bsams pa la/ oṃ āḥhri hūm̐ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /dge slong 'phags pas byi ba'i lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes lnga la thang skyar sbyar ba'o// // ( lu phu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /rten 'brel snying po'i them yig bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa dāt/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ rten 'brel snying po'i them yig la/ mthug gsum log gsum shad ni gcig /ring po brgyad du shes par bya/

/dha mthug gnyis dang bha mthug gcig /sha log gnyis dang na log gcig /shā log gnyis dang wā gnyis dang*/ /rmā dang thā dāt hā rnams ring*/ /dāt dang te yi bar na shad/ /gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags gsum/ /dbu na oṃ dang mthar swā hā/ /gsang sngags kyi ni rten 'brel te/ /oṃ dang swā hā mi ldan na// spyan 'byed kyi ni sngags yin gsungs/ /dbu na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /mjug tu swā hā gzungs sngags lugs/ /dbu ye dhar mjug tu ṇaḥ rig sngags lugs zhes chos rjes gsungs/ /bod skad bsgyur na 'di skad du/ /chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung*/ /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /de la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sam yang na 'di ltar 'byung*| chos gang rgyus byung de dag ni/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal to/ /de skad gsung pas dge sbyong che/ /zhes so/ /chos rje sa skya pa'i gsungs sgros 'phags pas mdzad// rten 'brel snying po'i them yig 'di'i ma phyi ni bdag phur pa phrin las kyi pha sngags 'chang dkar dga'i zhal 'don las rnyed pa der dpe bshus nas 'dir 'jog pa zhig yin no// //

༄༅/ /'o na 'o skol thams cad skye ba snga ma la bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis mi'-i lus rin po che thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang 'jal/ de ltar gyur pa'i gnas skabs 'dir chos re ma byas na skye ba phyi ma gar skye mi shes pas shin tu 'jigs pa lags/ chos byed pa la thog mar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ skyabs su song nas sems can la sangs rgyas kyi sa bon bzhag pa'i phyir/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa byed dgos pa lags/ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i sngon du/ sngar byas pa'i sdig pa rnams bshags dgos pas/ sdig pa bshags par bgyi bas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum spyan drang*/ de'i mdun du rang gis sngar byas pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags snyam du bsgoms la bdag gis lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas las dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las ci bgyis pa thams cad so sor bshags shing yang mi bgyid do zhes lan gcig brjod do/ /de ltar sdig pa bshags pa byas pas sdig pa thams cad 'dag pa lags/ sdig pa dag pa'i rjes su dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel dgos pas de'i don du rjes su yi rangs ba bgyi bas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rjes su yi rangs snyam du bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod/ so so'i skye bo dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la dga' zhing rjes su yid rangs bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gcig brjod do/ /des rang gi rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba dpag tu med pa 'phel ba lags/

de ltar sdig pa dag cing dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phel ba'i rjes su dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyun mi 'chad par bya ba'i phyir/ rten khyad par can la brten dgos pas skyabs su 'gro ba bgyi bas bdag dus 'di nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs snyam du bsgom la bdag gi lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying por mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mch-i'o/ / 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar skyabs su song bas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor legs par zhugs shing sdom pa thams cad kyi rten dang ldan par gyur pa lags| skyabs su 'gro ba thob nas sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa skye bas/ de'i phyir sems bskyed pa bgyi bas sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa bzhin du/ bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bya snyam du bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom 'das de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam la bslabs pa de bzhin du bdag gis kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed nas/

byang chub sems dpa'i lam thams cad la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa thob pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi sras su gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i ming thob| dge ba'i rtsa ba rgyun mi 'chad cing mthar thug mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba lags/ de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa blangs pa dang*/ gzhan yang khyed rang gis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad chud mi za zhing sangs rgyas thob ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir bsngo ba bgyi bas bdag dang gzhan gyis byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gcig tu sdoms la sangs rgyas su bsngo snyam du bsgoms la bdag gi lad mo mdzod gcig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ /ma lus blo yis gcig tu sdom byas nas/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis||bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// gnas skabs su bdag cag tshe ring ba nad med pa longs spyod che ba bar chad zhi ba bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub pa shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa bsngo ba dang bcas pa legs par thob pa don shin tu che ba lags// //( 'di ni 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung sems bskyed cho ga la sogs zhes pa'i tshan pa'i rjes la 'dug pas 'phags pa'i gsung yin bsam nas 'dir bsdus pa yin/ / ) ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams dang bcom ldan 'das kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas kye'i rdo rje bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i lto ba yangs par gyur pa'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du/

dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du ro'i gdan bsam/ de'i steng du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ sngon por bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ zhu ba las rang nyid kye'i rdo rje pad+ma dang nyi ma dang*/ ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po bsgom/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgom pa'i he ru ka lta bu sangs rgyas dang byang chub dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas ye shes pa rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs la/ de la snga ma bzhin mchod pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung shing*/ bum pa'i chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa kye'i rdo rje'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu yin snyam du yun ring du bsgom/

bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang lha skur gsal btab la lus skyil mo krung bca'/ lag pa mnyam gzhag byas la/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar a me'i rang bzhin shad lta bu/ spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar thig les yongs su gang ba'i haṃ dkar po mgo thur la lta ba de gnyis a wa dhu tis sbrel bar bsam/ de nas lte ba'i a las me 'bar bas a wa dhu ti'i nang du zhugs nas spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas thig le'i rgyun 'dzags te/ lte ba'i rtsa rnams kyi nang nas brgyud lus thig les yongs su gang bas bde ba dang mi rtog pa zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nus pas lte ba'i me'i nus pa cher 'phel nas drod bskyed par bsams la rlung kha sbyar bsgom mo/ /rgyun du bsgoms na ye shes skye zhing bde bas lus rgyas pa dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ drod skye ba la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bdag la zhugs nas/ nad dang sdig pa dag nas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags mi skyo'i bar du bzlas so/ / bzlas pa tshar ba dang dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gtor ma gtong ba'i dus su gtor ma bshams la/ rang nyid kye'i rdo rje yin snyam du bsgom/ oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gtor ma'i ma dag pa thams cad bsang*/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bha wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ brjod pas gtor ma stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa chen po 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam pa gcig bskyed/

de'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum bsgom de zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye'i rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpag tu med pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par ba bsams la/ de rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams zhing rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaṃ ad+ya nud pan na twata/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis dbul lo/ /oṃ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod pa lngas mchod nas bdag gi bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang*/ tshe ring ba dang*/ dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad sbyin du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas oṃ badz+ra mu zhes brjod pas lha rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas nub mo nyal ba'i tshe rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad bdag la bsdu/ de'ang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ nam mkha'i 'ja' yal ba bzhin du stong par gyur par bsams la stong pa'i ngang la gnyid log nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ldang ba ni skad cig gis rang gi shes pa hūm̐ du gyur/ hūm̐ las lha'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud thams cad gsal bar dmigs la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gsal gdab bo||ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas khrus byed pa'i tshe rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de la mchod pas mchod/ bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus bdag gi spyi bo nas blug pas/

bdag gi phyi nang gi dṛ ma thams cad dag par bsams la/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas shing khrus bya'o/ khrus tshar ba dang badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas lha rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas kha zas za ba'i tshe/ rang he ru kar gsal bar bsgom/ snying khar ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsam/ kha zas gtor ma ltar ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi lus kyi lha dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'/ kha zas bzang po la chags pa dang ngan pa la sdang ba mi bya/ lhag ma la oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ta ha ri bh+ya swāhā/ zhes brjod pas/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po la sbyin/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /thun mtshams kyi bya ba la/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang gi lus dang phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad lha skur bsam/ rang gi ngag tu ci brjod pa thams cad dang phyi rol gyi sgra grag pa thams cad sngags su bsam/ sems kyi bsams pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin du bsam la/ 'dod pa'i don longs spyod thams cad la ma chags zhing lha yis lha mchod pa'i bsam pas kha na ma tho ba'i las spangs te ci bde bar longs spyod do||spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /rnal 'byor de dag gis nyin zhag phrugs gcig gis dus 'da' bar byas na myur du rdzaugs pa'i sangs rgyas kye'i rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro// //thub pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho yi/ /snying po bas kyang snying po mchog / kye'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul 'di ni/ /ji bzhin sgrubs na 'bras mchog ldan/ /rgyal bu jim gyin gyis bskul nas/ /de mnyes bya phyir 'phags pa yis/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i/ /gnas mchog kha'i phing hur sbyar/ /dge ba de yis 'gro ba kun/ /kye'i rdo rje nyid gyur cig |lcags pho spre'u'i lo rgyal bu rgyal sar byung dus su sbyar ba rdzogs so/

/ 'di bris dge ba bdag gi bgyis pa gang*/ /de'i theg chen lam mchog 'di zhugs nas/ /bla med byang chub myur du thob gyur nas/ /'gro don 'bad med lhun grub 'byung bar shog/ // ( lu phu'i dpe las byung*/ )( bde mchog sdom tshig ) ༄༅/ / sdom tshig 'di bzung na bde/ rten srung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa| dang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bsnyen sogs sbyor ba 'i ting nge 'dzin/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgoms pa rnams te/ ste/ / mngal du/ bskyed pa dang de nas/ 'byin zhing so so'i gnas su spro ba dang sngags kyis/ byin brlabs rang*/ go cha dgod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ /ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ dag pa rnams| las rgyal mchog go// /sngon tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ 'gro rjes bzlas pa gtor ma thun mtshams kyi bya ba/ rnams phal cher gzhan dang mthun/ ( bde mchog sdom tshig 'phags pa'i gsung gi rjes la yod pas ji bzhin bsdus/ / )( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /mgon po'i sku bzhengs thabs/ / ༄༅/ /thog mar shing las byas pa'i rgyus shing de'i dbu'i nang gi shing la brkos nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang gzungs ring bsrel/ khyad par du kye'i aṣ+ta de wa pi tsu kirti ri

rdorje'i snying po thams cad tshan pa gser gyis bris nas gser gyi ga'u 'am dngul gyi ga'u'i nang du bcug nas dbu'i nang du bcug shing gis kha chod bya/ bla ma'i rten mtshan 'bum nas ring bsrel la sogs tshe de dang lan gcig bcug kyang nyan/ yang na mgrin par ga'u gcig byas nas bcug kyang nyan| thugs kar yang khar sing gdam ngag gi nang na yod pa bzhin gri snying la bca' ba de 'phrod na rab da res la de ma 'phrod na/ ga'u la snying gi gzungs byas nas/ de'i nang du 'khor ma gtogs pa/ ma hā kā la lcam dral gyi snying po nye snying rtsa oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa sha sa na dang ru ru sogs yum gyi sngags }gas rnams gser gyis bris la bcug lto bar phyogs skyong bcu/ rgyal chen sde bzhi/ lha chen po brgyad/ gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ 'jig byed dgu/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi snying po bris la bcug rkang pa'i bol gnyis la/ pu tra lcam dral gyi snying po bris la/ sngags kyi spar bu gru gsum pa byas nas/ de'i nang du bzhag la bcug rkang pa'i rtse mo gnyis kyis srog shing gi mā ra ya'i rtse mor phur pa'i gzugs byas la/ dgra dang bgegs rnams kyi ling ga bris la/ de'i 'og tu bcug 'di rnams nang du ma bcug pa'i gong du/ rab gnas gcig byed/ rab gnas tshar ba dang*/ nang ljongs byed/ ling ga la rab gnas mi dgos/ dgug bzhug byas la bcug srog shing de blang ba'i dus su mā hā ka lar mchod pa bshams bskyed nas gtor ma btang| me tog dor/ 'jim pa'i gzugs tshar ba'i dus su'ang de bzhin bya/ tshon gsol tshar ba dang yang de bzhin bya/ spyan dbye ba'i dus su'ang rab gnas chen po bya/ de rnams byed pa'i bar du yang*/ sngags thun dang*/ gsol ba btab na snyan pa dang*/ bkra shis pa 'ong pa yin/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal pos rang gi bu chen gyi chos skyong gi sku bzhengs pa'i dus su gnang ba'i man ngag khyad par can yin no/

/'di'i ma dpe rgya shog la bris pa gcig 'dug go/ // mgon po'i sku bzhengs thabs 'di/ bka' 'bum dkar chag na mi 'dug cing lung yang ma thob/ 'phags pa'i bka' 'bum gcig yin pa kun gzhon spe dang gcig 'chad pa thos so// ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /bir srung 'phags pas mdzad pa'o/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan bir+wa pa bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang gi mdun du gdan seng ge'i khri'am/ pad ma'i sdong po'am/ dpag bsam gyi shing ngam gang mos pa la byas pas chog gsung ngo*/ /de'i steng du slob dpon chen po bir+wa pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog sngo nag tu yod pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan steng du mnan pa/ g.yon pas nyi ma gteng par bcug pa'i brdar sdigs 'dzub nyi zla la bstan par bzung ba/ 'gying bag dang ldan pa/ me tog gi phreng bas dbu brgyan pa gcig tu bsam mo/ /de nas de la mos gus drag po gcig byas la/ tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par sngags 'di brgya'am/ stong la sogs pa bgrang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu li/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ghu li/ badz+ra ka pā li/ badz+ra dhi na/ bha dhu a ra/ badz+ra pi aṃ/ u tsaṃ ghe/ sa ra bhe ta na/ li ke e/ aṃ ke i/ mi li lo ga sa ra ta/ ta u la/ ti pa ta/ oṃ bi ru wa sa ra ṇa/ mo we ta ni wa ra ṇa/ sngags 'di chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag dpe dngos la btugs pa'i zhu dag byas nas bris gsungs so/ / badz+ra ka pā la/ badz+ra dhi na/ bha du a ra| badz+ra pi aṃ hu tsaṃ ge sa ra bhe dha na/ kha ga le/ aṃ ge mi li/ le ga par ta/ ta 'u la ti pa ra/ a bhi tu wa sa ra naṃ/ mo bhe da na/ wa ra ṇa zhes ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzlas la/ phyi nang gis mchod cing bstod par bya/ mthar bdag la bstim pa'am/ mi dmigs par bsam pa gang bde bya gsung*/

bsrung ba ni/ chu gtsang khyor ba gang g.yon par blugs la/ g.yas pa'i srin lag gis dkrug cing sngags de nyid lan ci rigs par bzlas la/ srin lag gis dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha gsum du thig le bya'o/ /gdon gyi bar chad shin tu che ba'i gnas su sdod pa'am 'gro ba'i tshe/ shin tu skrag snyam na/ rang gi dri chu blugs la srin lag gis krug cing*/ sngags bdun nam nyer gcig bzlas te mig gis mi lta| de nas srin lag g.yas pas chu de blangs la/ mig gis mi mthong bar phrag pa g.yas nas bskor nas gong ngos nas dpral ba lce rtse snying kha gsum du reg par bya ste/ bsrung ba'i mchog go /bsrung ba gzhan yang rdo rje rtse gsum gyis bsrung ba ni/ rnam 'byor dbang phyug tu dran par byas la/ g.yon pa rtse gsum du byas te/ gnas lngar gtugs la/ a k+ṣe bhi ma/ pa tshe u si ma/ ṣi la pa tha ra/ u pa tshe u/ wa pa/ bir+wa pā/ pra/ sa/ t+yaṃ/ swā hā/ sngags 'di chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag dpe la btugs pa'i zhus dag byas pa nas bris gsung ngo*/ / aṃ ge'u bhi ma/ pa tse'u shi la/ shi la sa tha ra/ ham ngu a tse'u/ wa pa/ bir+wa/ pra sa dhe swāhā/ zhes pa'i rim pa dang*/ bzlog pa'i rim pas phyag rgya dang ldan pas so/ /phyag rgya'i bsrung ba ni/ rkang pa'i brang pa sa la btsugs la rting pa 'phongs tshos la gtad/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong mdzub mo mthe'u chung rnams rtse sprad nas brkyang pa'i phyag rgya snying khar bcas la/ de yar bzlog cing 'dzub mo snying khar reg mthe'u chung lce la reg cing*/ mar bzlog nas mthe'u chung dang mthe bong lte bar reg cing*/ bo la mtheb mdzub kyi bar nas phyung la/ mthe'u chung bshang lam du reg par bya'o/ /lan gsum du byas la bshang lam du dgrol bar bya'o/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas bsrung ba ni/ thal mo mnyam du sbyar ba kha phye la srin lag gnyis kyi rtsa ba mthe bos mnan nas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/

/oṃ ra ga dza ṭa/ oṃ ra ga dzā ṭa/ ra ga ṭa phaṭa/ bir wa ka nir la thā/ mo na thi bhā ya/ sngags 'di chos rje sa paṇa gyi phyag dpe la btugs nas zhu dag byas pa las bris gsungs so// ra ga ta dza ṭa/ ra ga ta phaṭa/ bir wa ka ni la ṭa/ mo na thi bhā ya/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod la/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil du g.yas pa'i sor mo lan gsum bzhi brdab bo/ /dmigs pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba ni/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ mgo thur la lta ba yis dbu ma'i yar rtse bkag lte ba'i aṃ mgo gyen la lta ba yis mar rtse bkag pa la dmigs pa gtad do/ /de dag gis ni phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad zhi bar 'gyur te/ gtso bor gzhi ji bzhin pa'i bsrung ba'o/ /'gro ba'i tshe bsrung ba ni| yi ges sgo dgag pa rim pa bzhin byas la phyogs rnam par gnon pa ni/ rlung mi rgyu ba ngos kyi rkang pa mnan/ rgyu ba'i ngos kyi lag pa thal mo sbyar nas/ gom pa bdun song bas/ lam du chu dang*/ rbab dang*/ gza' dang*/ thog dang*/ phyogs kyi nyes pa dang*/ gcan gzan la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las bsrung bar 'gyur ro/ /nyal ba'i tshe gzhogs g.yas 'og tu bcug la/ g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung gis sna bug g.yas pa bkag nas nyal na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /de dag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nyid kyis/ rje sa skya pa chen po la/ rgyud sde bdun cu don gnyis kyi lung gnang ba'i tshe/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag 'di'ang gnang ba'o/ /zab mo yi ger bkod pa las/ /bdag la cung zad nyes mchis gang*/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par gsol/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i man ngag gsungs pa/ 'phags pas shin tu zhib par bkod pa'o/ /shubhaṃ// // ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ༄༅/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i bsgom bzlas bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i sgrub pa po rnams kyis rang gi srog dang 'dra bar bsrung dgos pa ni/

bla mas bstan pa'i dam tshig yin la/ de dag ma nyams par bsrung na mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i yang gzhi ma'am 'bras bu yin pas/ de dag bsrung ba la nan tan cher bya dgos pa'o| |gal te dam tshig de dag so so nas bsrung bar ma nus sam/ nyes pa'i dri mas phog pa gyur na/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi nyams su blangs na/ sngar nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing phyis nyams pa'i nyes pa gang gis kyang mi gos par 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyud las/ bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba la/ /nye bar bsgrub pa nyid dang ni/ /bsgrub pa don gyi dam tshig dang*/ /sgrub pa chen po nyid dang ni/ /bsnyen sgrub bzhi yi sbyor ba yis| |sgrub pa po rnams dag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi pa 'di ltar nyams su blangs te/ dben pa'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug la/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi rgyud dag cing*/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la/ mos gus drag po bya ste/ nyes ltung thams cad 'dag par gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ snang dmigs kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du dran pa bya/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid khaṃ ljang khu zhig tu gyur par bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa zhig tu gyur par bsam/ de spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na ral gri/ g.yon na des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis thugs kar bsnol ba/ yum dam tshig rdo rje sgrol ma phyag g.yas na gri gug dang*/ g.yon na thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul pa la 'khyud pa/

gnyis ka'ang 'dzum zhing cung zad khro ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi sham thabs grol ba/ rdo rje'i skyil krung g-is bzhugs shing*/ zla ba la rgyab brten par bsams te/ de lta bur gsal bar bskyed pa ni dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /de nas gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gi steng du hūm̐ nag po/ thugs kyi nang du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa ljang khu/ de rnams gdan zla ba'i steng du bsam pa ste/ gnyis pa nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag go /de'i thugs ka'i khaṃ las 'od zer 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs te/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rnam par byon nas dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos/ dgug bcing gzhug pa dang*/ gnyis su med par dgyes pa bskyed pa ni/ gsum pa sgrub pa'i yan lag go /de nas bdag nyid kyi thugs ka'i khaṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig ma lha mo dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/ yid kyi cung zad mchod de/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa nas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad khyab nas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag ste/ chu'i lhag ma gyen la lud pa las/ spyi bor dam tshig rdo rje gong gi ci 'dra ba thugs kar ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pas dbu brgyan par bsam zhing*/ de'i spyi bor yang sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram gyis mtshan pa ni/ sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /de nas spyi bo'i bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i thugs ka'i khaṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ bdag gi spyi bo'i tshangs pa'i sgo nas mar babs pas lus thams cad bdud rtsis dkar mer gyis gang ste/ spyir las kyi sgrib pa dang dam tshig nyams pa'i tshogs thams cad dang*/

bye brag tu gang nyes pa byas pa rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsis ded nas/ 'og sgo gnyis dang*| rkang mthil gnyis nas thon te/ kha dog nag po'i gzugs kyis nag nu ru ru thon 'gro bar bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ a khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa yi ge bdun po 'di ci nus su bzlas la/ thun 'jog khar dbu rgyan gyi lha spyi bo nas mar thim ste/ sdig pa thams cad dag nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /de lta bu thun bzhi ru byas pa'i dus kyi nges pa zla ba drug gam/ gcig gam/ phyed la sogs pa dang grangs kyi nges pa bdun 'bum la sogs pa'am| mtshan ma'i nges pa lus las ngan skyugs 'thon pa'am/ gos dkar po gon pa'am/ khrus byas pa'am/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i rmi lam bzang po byung byung gi bar du byas pas/ nyes pa che 'bring chung gsum thams cad 'dag par 'gyur la/ thun gcig byas na'ang nyin zhag gi nyes pa 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /jo bo nā ro pa nas brgyud pa/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i khyad par gyi gdams pa/ dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa las ldang ba'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa tshegs chung la don che ba'i gdams pa yin no// //a+thi+-i// // ( zha lu'i dpe las byung*/ ) ¿ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab yang skong*/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 234PAGE 233
